contexts.text: The cup = the truth of faith; and to worship this without its good, is to cleanse in the outside of the cup...
Purification is here understood by purifying and refining them as gold and silver.
The house swept () = life against truths.
To cleanse the inside of the cup and of the platter () = to purify the interiors, which are of the will and thought, thus of love and faith, through the Word.
The spirit of cleansing () = the affection of spiritual truth, for this cleanses.

To plant it, to cleanse before it, and to cause its roots to take root () = instruction according to order, which is; first, the imbuing of knowledges; next, being in the wilderness and being tempted; and afterwards, being introduced into the Land of Canaan, that is, into the Church; which three things are here signified by these words.
